title: Valmont Valley Center Pivot
description: A Valley center pivot irrigation system managed through the AgSense 365 or BaseStation3 platform

id.description: Unique identifier for the pivot device

status.description: Current operational status of the pivot

position.description: Current angular position of the pivot in degrees

speed.description: Pivot speed as percent timer (100% = maximum speed)

endGunActive.description: Whether the end gun is currently active

waterApplied.description: Total water applied in inches for the current program

flowRate.description: Current flow rate in gallons per minute

latitude.description: Pivot center latitude in decimal degrees

longitude.description: Pivot center longitude in decimal degrees

fieldName.description: Name of the field where the pivot is located
